name: Virtua Soldier
bio: Low-poly, high morale. Counts his edges before every drop and has never come up one short.
notes: A Meshy community model, CC0 per the owner (from the owner's Drive folder, 2026-11-01, second batch; the community model's name as the download names it): a textured GLB in a T-pose, not rigged (no skin), so it is rigged here from T-pose landmarks found on the mesh (landmarks.mjs). A low-poly soldier in blue faceted camouflage, a plate carrier and a helmet with goggles. His right hand's fingers were read as split and crumpled into shards on the grip: it bends as a mitten (`mitten`, curl 1.2).

source.author: Meshy community (author not recorded; CC0 per the owner)
